name: Doorbell Overlay
description: Doorbell camera overlay for Kiosk Satellite screensavers and Fotoo with dual triggers, individual detection and doorbell ring sizing, positions and durations.
author: Local Kiosk Satellite project

settings.title: Show overlay on
settings.description: Choose whether the doorbell camera is shown on Kiosk Satellite's own screensavers, Fotoo, or both.

settings.title: Visibility entity (optional)
settings.description: Optional Home Assistant entity that controls whether this overlay is allowed to appear.

settings.title: Visibility condition
settings.description: Active recognizes on, true, home, playing, open, detected, occupied and present. Time between does not need an entity.

settings.title: Visibility value
settings.description: Value for the condition. Examples: on, 30, 10..200, or 22:00-06:00.

settings.title: Default camera entity
settings.description: Primary Home Assistant camera entity (e.g. camera.doorbellcamera).

settings.title: Trigger 1 entity (detection)
settings.description: Detection trigger, for example a Frigate person occupancy binary_sensor.

settings.title: Trigger 1 label
settings.description: Label badge shown on overlay for trigger 1 (leave empty to hide label).

settings.title: Trigger 1 camera size
settings.description: Camera width as a percentage of screen width when trigger 1 activates.

settings.title: Trigger 1 camera position
settings.description: Screen position for trigger 1 camera overlay.

settings.title: Trigger 1 display time
settings.description: How long the camera stays visible for trigger 1.

settings.title: Trigger 2 entity (doorbell ring)
settings.description: Doorbell ring button trigger, for example a Reolink visitor binary_sensor.

settings.title: Trigger 2 camera entity (optional)
settings.description: Optional secondary camera entity for trigger 2. If left empty, default camera entity is used.

settings.title: Trigger 2 label
settings.description: Label badge shown on overlay for trigger 2 (leave empty to hide label).

settings.title: Trigger 2 camera size
settings.description: Camera width as a percentage of screen width when trigger 2 activates.

settings.title: Trigger 2 camera position
settings.description: Screen position for trigger 2 camera overlay.

settings.title: Trigger 2 display time
settings.description: How long the camera stays visible for trigger 2.
